title: Four-milestone CLI built across two sessions with no shared memory

requirements.text: M1: add and list work and persist to notes.json
M2: delete works, unknown ids fail with exit code 1, ids are never reused
M3: search is case-insensitive and list --tag filters exactly
M4: export to Markdown and JSON, to stdout or a file
A missing notes.json is treated as empty; a corrupted one fails with exit code 1 and is left untouched
test_notes.py covers every milestone and passes
After the first session M1 and M2 work and a written handoff names what is left
Work from the first session still works at the end
